tool_input.command: try { $dictionaryResponse = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://172.27.13.11:8080/system/dict/data/type/DOCUMENT_TYPE' -Method Get -TimeoutSec 15; $dictionaryItems = @($dictionaryResponse.data | ForEach-Object { '{0}:{1}' -f $_.dictValue, $_.dictLabel }); 'HTTP 200; options={0}' -f ($dictionaryItems -join ' | ') } catch { 'Dictionary request failed; error type={0}' -f $_.Exception.GetType().Name }

parts.tool_output: [{"type":"text","text":"HTTP 200; options=001:居民身份证 | 002:统一社会信用代码证 | 003:港澳台身份证 | 004:护照 | 005:户口簿 | 006:军官证（士兵证） | 007:组织机构代码 | 008:营业执照 | 009:其它\r\n"}]
